page.heading: Schedule
page.placingHint: Pick a slot for {label}. Press Escape to cancel.
page.creatingHint: Pick a slot for the new event. Press Escape to cancel.
page.noGridBody: A schedule needs a TimeGrid: how long a block is, how many run per day, and which days this institution teaches on. Nothing is assumed on your behalf.
page.noTermsBody: Create a term to place sessions into.
page.locked: Locked {label} in place. The next solve will leave it alone.
page.unlocked: Unlocked {label}. The next solve may move it.
page.termGone: That term no longer exists. Showing the current one.
page.filtersDropped: Could not apply the {filters} filter from this link. Showing everything.

violations.repairNote: A repair moves as little as possible and produces a proposal to review; it never changes the timetable on its own.
violations.roomDoubleBooked: Room already booked at this time: {rooms}

blockedDay.dialogLabel: Declare a day you cannot teach
blockedDay.help: Pick a day in the week you're viewing. {emphasis}, not applied immediately, because a declared day is a hard rule for the scheduler, so it is reviewed first.

relation.groupsHelp: Nesting propagates: choosing a cohort also covers its seminars.
relation.groupsEmptyHint: No groups available in this term.
relation.lecturerHelp: Who leads this session. Changing it here overrides what the Offering or the solver assigned, permanently. That is the whole reason a lock is required first.
relation.peopleHelp: Individuals attending in their own right, beyond whole groups.
relation.peopleEmptyHint: No people in this institution yet.
relation.substituteHelp: Somebody else teaches this one occurrence. The original lecturer keeps the Offering and this reverts on its own next week; nothing here is permanent.
relation.substituteEmptyHint: Nobody is free to cover this slot right now.

eventForm.title: New event
eventForm.note: An event stands on its own: no recurring demand behind it. It occupies this room and block, and no solve will move or remove it.
eventForm.noteCalendar: Marking a range of DATES instead (a holiday, a break, an exam period) is {link}, not an event.
eventForm.name: Name
eventForm.namePlaceholder: Open day, exam sitting, staff meeting…
eventForm.noKinds: This tenant has no session kinds yet. One is required, and they are managed under Session kinds.
eventForm.kindsUnreadable: Session kinds could not be read, and an event needs one. Ask for the session-kind read permission.
eventForm.lockedHelp: An event is already exempt from solves because it has no offering; this additionally stops a manual re-place.

inspector.emptyReadonly: Select a session to see its details
inspector.banked: In the spare bank, not currently placed.
inspector.multiRoomHint: The solver places a session in one room; the extras are kept here but not sent to it.
inspector.lecturerLockHint: Lock this session to override who teaches it, otherwise the next solve would silently replace your choice.
inspector.violationsNote: Recorded, not blocking. The edit that caused this was allowed.
inspector.unlockBeforeMove: Unlock this session before moving it.
inspector.swapHint: Now choose the session to swap places with.
inspector.unlockBeforeBank: Unlock this session before moving it to the spare bank.
inspector.deleteConfirm: Delete this event? It is not backed by an offering, so nothing will re-create it.
inspector.viewOnly: You have view-only access to this schedule.

solver.budgetHint: Whichever is reached first ends the run.
solver.budgetCaption: ends at {moves} moves or {seconds}s, whichever first
solver.confirmCancel: Cancel this run? Its work is discarded and no proposal is produced.
solver.doneHintNoPermission: A proposal was produced. Reviewing it needs the generation.read permission.
solver.doneHintStatusUnknown: Could not read the proposal’s status.
solver.doneHintOtherStatus: The proposal is {status} and is not awaiting a decision.
solver.runCancelled: Run cancelled: no proposal was produced.
solver.resultLost: The run succeeded, but its result could not be retrieved from the solver. Nothing was lost from the schedule; run it again to get a proposal.
solver.adoptedRepair: A repair was already running for this term.
solver.adoptedRebuild: A run was already in progress for this term.
solver.adoptedRebuildInsteadOfRepair: A full rebuild was already running for this term, so this is showing that instead of a repair: it replaces the whole timetable, not just the clashes.
solver.adoptedRepairInsteadOfRebuild: A repair was already running for this term, so this is showing that instead of a full rebuild: it only moves what it must.

editing.bankFailed: Could not move that session to the spare bank.

proposals.heading: Proposals
proposals.lead: Proposed schedules, mostly the solver's. Applying one replaces that term's timetable and leaves every other term alone; nothing here changes anything until you do.
proposals.loadFailed: Could not load proposals. Nothing has been changed. Try again.
proposals.emptyTermReady: Nothing for {term} is awaiting a decision. Other terms may have proposals; clear the term filter to see them.
proposals.emptyTermAll: Nothing for {term} has been produced yet. Other terms may have proposals; clear the term filter to see them.
proposals.emptyReady: Every proposal has been applied or discarded. Generate a schedule from the toolbar on the schedule page to produce a new one.
proposals.emptyAll: The solver has not produced a schedule for this institution yet. Open the schedule, pick a term, and choose {action}.
proposals.bestOf: best of {count} on the same input
proposals.truncated: Showing the {limit} most recent proposals. Older ones are not listed.

review.heading: Proposal
review.readonly: You can review this proposal but not apply it.
review.discardedDetail: {version} stays on record and can no longer be applied.
review.writingPlacements: Writing placements. A large proposal takes a few seconds.
review.confirmApplyNote: Every locked session is left alone, and {version} stays on record; the schedule it replaces remains as an earlier version.
review.confirmDiscardNote: It stays on record but can no longer be applied. Nothing on the current schedule changes.
review.noRun: Nothing to review: this Generation was not produced by a solver run.
review.destructive: {count} session will be removed. The solver could not place these; applying deletes them rather than leaving them where it rejected them. | {count} sessions will be removed. The solver could not place these; applying deletes them rather than leaving them where it rejected them.
review.totalCollateral: of those moves were not asked for
review.terminalCurrentDetail: {version} was applied and is what this term runs on. Nothing here is awaiting a decision.
review.terminalReplacedDetail: {version} was applied, then a later proposal took over. It is a record now.
review.terminalSupersededDetail: This proposal was discarded or superseded. It stays on record and can no longer be applied.
review.terminalOtherDetail: It is not awaiting a decision.

reviewSummary.hardSurviving: {count} hard-rule issue survives in this proposal | {count} hard-rule issues survive in this proposal
reviewSummary.unmappable: {locatable} of {total} session references can be located; {unmappable} name sessions the solver created and cannot be pinned to a slot.
reviewSummary.forcedOnlineHead: {count} of those breaches cannot be fixed by moving anything: the group's own teaching has to be online. | {count} of those breaches cannot be fixed by moving anything: those groups' own teaching has to be online.
reviewSummary.forcedOnlineGroup: {group}: {forced} of {total} sessions must be online, above the {percent}% cap.
reviewSummary.forcedOnlineWeek: Forced online by: {offerings}. The cap is measured per week, so at least one week must exceed it however the term is spread.
reviewSummary.forcedOnlineFix: Raise the cap, or allow these offerings on site. Until then the solver reports the breach on every run, and no arrangement of sessions will clear it.
reviewSummary.clear: Every hard rule the solver checks is satisfied.
reviewSummary.compare: Separately, Calendry's own {rules} structural checks find {count} issue on the live schedule (a different rule set), so the two counts are not a like-for-like difference. | Separately, Calendry's own {rules} structural checks find {count} issues on the live schedule (a different rule set), so the two counts are not a like-for-like difference.
reviewSummary.lockedValue: {count} session left exactly as they are | {count} sessions left exactly as they are
reviewSummary.demandShortValue: The solver returned {returned} of the {required} placements this run asked it for, across {count} offering. | The solver returned {returned} of the {required} placements this run asked it for, across {count} offerings.
reviewSummary.withheldValue: {count} existing session is being kept rather than removed: the run said nothing about it, which is not the same as refusing to place it. | {count} existing sessions are being kept rather than removed: the run said nothing about them, which is not the same as refusing to place them.
reviewSummary.unverifiedValue: This run predates the check that confirms the solver answered in full, so its {count} removal cannot be told apart from placements it simply left out. | This run predates the check that confirms the solver answered in full, so its {count} removals cannot be told apart from placements it simply left out.
reviewSummary.unverifiedFix: Re-run the solve to get a proposal that can be checked.
reviewSummary.unplaceableValue: {count} session this proposal wants cannot be recorded, and will not be created | {count} sessions this proposal wants cannot be recorded, and will not be created
reviewSummary.scoreValue: {score} (lower is better, and only comparable with other proposals for the same term).

reviewChanges.none: This proposal changes nothing. Every offering in the term is reproduced exactly where it already sits.
reviewChanges.notAsked: not in what you asked for
reviewChanges.untouched: {count} other offering is reproduced exactly as it stands. | {count} other offerings are reproduced exactly as they stand.

termination.unknown: Unknown. This run predates termination capture.
termination.converged: Found an optimal solution and stopped.
termination.moveBudget: Ran out of move budget. A longer run may do better.
termination.timeBudget: Ran out of time. Not reproducible. A re-run may differ.
termination.stagnated: Gave up before placing everything: some sessions have no slot in this proposal.
termination.unrecognised: Ended for a reason this version does not recognise ({reason}).

loadFailure.forbiddenDetail: Reviewing proposals needs the generation.read permission. Ask a tenant administrator to grant it.
loadFailure.notFoundDetail: It may have been removed, or the link may point at another institution.
loadFailure.failedDetail: The preview did not come back. Nothing has been changed. Try again.

reviewAction.discardLostContact: Lost contact while trying to discard this proposal, so it is not known whether it went through. Refresh before trying again.

reviewAction.discardedNoRefresh: Discarded. The view could not be refreshed. Reload to see it.
